messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high-error-rate detected on api-gateway (eu-west-1). 502/504 spike, p95 latency up. Paging SRE on-call: @sara.

sara: I am on it — paging in here. seeing lots of 502 responses from gateway/edge. any recent deploys? :eyes:

mike: not from edge team in last 30m. last deploy was a routing optimizer 45m ago but that targeted dedicated pools only.

raj: I'm looking at proxy pools. envoy cluster 'api-gateway-eu-west' shows 60% of upstream hosts unhealthy, connection errors and 504s.

laura: Support note — multiple customers reporting request failures to /v1/generate, some timeouts. Ticket #INC-5821 opened.

sara: good context. mike/raj — can you post quick `curl` and `kubectl` checks you run so we know state?

mike: run: ```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood-eu.example.com/v1/health
# result: 502 0.38
```

raj: kubectl snippet: ```
kubectl get pods -n gateway -o wide | grep api-proxy
api-proxy-0   1/1 Running  5m   10.0.12.4
api-proxy-1   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff 1m   10.0.12.5
api-proxy-2   1/1 Running  2h   10.0.12.6
```

raj: logs show repeated upstream reset: ```
[error] upstream reset: connection reset by peer for host upstream-api-1
[warn] 2026-03-15T12:02:34Z: read timeout on tcp socket
```

mike: checking Envoy stats: cluster.api-backend.upstream_rq_5xx: 4.7k in last 5m, upstream_rq_timeout: 2.2k. circuit_breakers triggered on some hosts.

sara: do we have any traffic spikes? Ops dashboard? ops-bot, any traffic anomalies?

ops-bot: Traffic anomaly detected: incoming RPS to /v1/* increased 3.3x since 11:43Z from EU region. Top client = mobile-ingest-service (internal).

laura: paging customers: notify priority customers in eu-west that we're investigating; set expectation 30m.

mike: hypothesis: a recent routing change increased stickiness to a subset of upstreams, those hosts are overloaded and failing health checks. Also seeing higher TLS handshake latency on tcp level.

raj: mitigation options: 1) drain failing hosts from LB; 2) widen load balancing to backup pool; 3) rollback recent routing optimizer config; 4) raise proxy timeouts temporarily. Which should we try first?

sara: do 1 + 2 immediately. drain the CrashLoopBackOff pod and route traffic to backups. mike, can you trigger graceful drain?

mike: running: `kubectl cordon`/`kubectl drain` on api-proxy-1, then update Envoy via service discovery to exclude host.```

mike: executed drain, update published. Envoy reports host removed, draining connections.

raj: pushing config to expand cluster endpoints to include backup pool: `api-backend: add-backup=true` — pushed.

sara: monitoring impact...

(small pause)

mike: after drain + backup, 502 rates dropping: upstream_rq_5xx down 70% in the last 60s. p95 latency improving.

ops-bot: Metric check: 502 error rate decreased from 12% -> 3% over 3m. Customer request successes rising.

laura: support update sent to customer list. still some residual errors for long-lived streaming connections.

raj: long lived connections were hitting a keepalive-related bug on old proxy build. We should replace remaining old build instances.

sara: ok do a targeted rollout of new proxy build to eu-west with a canary 5% then ramp. mike, coordinate deploy. raj, confirm no config drift.

mike: starting canary deploy 5% now. watch for regressions.```

mike: canary looks fine so far, no 5xx spike. ramping to 50%.

(15 minutes later)

mike: full rollout to eu-west complete. all proxy instances on new build. 502/504 spike resolved.

raj: postmortem notes to capture: root cause = overloaded upstream hosts due to routing change + stale proxy build bug for keepalive; contributing factor = traffic burst from mobile-ingest-service. Mitigation steps = immediate drain + backup pool routing + proxy rollout.

sara: escalation closed to P0. on-call handoff: leaving for next rotation in 10m. Thanks all :tada: :heart: 

incident-bot: Incident resolved (duration ~32m). Create incident report and assign to eng-runtime and edge teams for action items.

laura: I'll file the customer incident summary and include rollback timeline + mitigation steps.

mike: action items: add automated rollback guard when routing changes push >2x traffic to single upstream; add health-check hysteresis.

raj: I'll own the postmortem and follow up with a patch for keepalive bug.

sara: closing thread, moving to postmortems. thanks everyone.
